verdict.rationale: Undermind generates AI insights inside the product. It writes syntheses with ranked papers, answers questions across many full-text PDFs including figures and tables, and alerts users to relevant new papers. Community users confirm the AI-generated results surface useful findings. These insights come from the scholarly literature corpus and the user's workspace of curated papers and notes, not clearly from the user's own uploaded data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of insights or suggestions generated from user-owned or uploaded data, and documentation of proactive in-product suggestions beyond new-paper alerts.
